# Work Anywhere

A curated resource for digital nomads and remote workers — city guides, visa breakdowns, job hunting, tools, finance, and lifestyle. Based on firsthand experience and community research, updated regularly through 2026.

## Core guides

- [Best places to work remotely 2026](https://workinanywhere.com/blog/best-cities-remote-work-2026): 15 cities with real cost data and visa rules
- [How to become a digital nomad 2026](https://workinanywhere.com/blog/how-to-become-digital-nomad-2026): Step-by-step path from zero to location independent
- [Spain digital nomad visa 2026](https://workinanywhere.com/blog/spain-digital-nomad-visa-2026): Application guide, real costs, tax rules
- [Best digital nomad destinations compared](https://workinanywhere.com/blog/best-digital-nomad-destinations-compared-2026): Side-by-side cost, internet, visa comparison
- [Digital nomad taxes 2026](https://workinanywhere.com/blog/digital-nomad-taxes-2026): Questions to ask a cross-border tax specialist

## City guides

- [Latin America remote work guide](https://workinanywhere.com/blog/latin-america-remote-work-guide-2026): 8 cities with real budgets
- [Costa Rica digital nomad guide](https://workinanywhere.com/blog/costa-rica-digital-nomad-guide-2026): Cost, visa, best towns
- [Croatia digital nomad guide](https://workinanywhere.com/blog/croatia-digital-nomad-guide-2026): Cost of living, visa, best cities
- [Bulgaria digital nomad guide](https://workinanywhere.com/blog/bulgaria-digital-nomad-guide-2026): EU residency, 10% flat tax
- [New Zealand digital nomad guide](https://workinanywhere.com/blog/new-zealand-digital-nomad-guide-2026): Visa rules, cost of living
- [Barcelona remote work guide](https://workinanywhere.com/blog/barcelona-remote-work-guide-2026): Cost, visa, Beckham Law

## Jobs and money

- [Remote jobs no experience 2026](https://workinanywhere.com/blog/remote-jobs-no-experience-2026): Entry level roles hiring now
- [Flexible remote jobs 2026](https://workinanywhere.com/blog/flexible-remote-jobs-2026): Part-time and schedule-flexible roles
- [Digital nomad budget breakdown](https://workinanywhere.com/blog/digital-nomad-budget-breakdown-2026): Three spending levels
- [Real nomad budgets from community](https://workinanywhere.com/blog/real-nomad-budgets-from-community): 50 nomads, 12 countries
- [Banking across borders: Wise vs Revolut](https://workinanywhere.com/blog/banking-across-borders-wise-revolut-2026): Fee comparison
- [Travel insurance for digital nomads](https://workinanywhere.com/blog/travel-insurance-digital-nomads-2026): Plans compared

## About this site

Work Anywhere publishes curated, well-researched guides for people who want to build a life that is not tied to a single zip code. Every article is written from firsthand experience or community-sourced research. No AI-generated filler.
